top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a specific, mature discovery chain (proglucagon processing and incretin physiology, identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, receptor biology) to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov, each step with a distinct, independently confirmed owner and a decisive change in the field through outcome-trial-proven therapies; the citation scope is accurate and no award would withhold clearly prize-worthy science.
